turns.text: health information request keeps failing with ABDM-1112 "Invalid or already expired consent artefact id". it worked last week with the same artefact. retrying doesnt help

must_contain: ABDM-1112 means the consent artefact is unknown or has expired, and an expired artefact is often not a bug because a consent window is allowed to end.
If you still need the data, raise a new consent request instead of retrying against the old artefact.
notes: A fetch that worked last week and fails now reads as a bug; the atoms say it is the consent ending. The same code means a DigiLocker gender mismatch in another module, so that meaning must not appear.
